name: zecswap-railgun-engine-check
description: Checks zecswap-railgun against Railgun's own engine: `npm ci`, then `node vectors.cjs > ../tests/engine-vectors.json`, or pipe `cargo run -p zecswap-railgun --example note` into `node check.cjs`
//: Overrides keep known-vulnerable packages out of this checker; none of them runs here.
.npmrc's legacy-peer-deps: react-native-fs (graphql-mesh, React Native only) made npm install React Native's toolchain, and chai-as-promised chai, as peers; Node never loads either.
axios, ws and underscore: patched releases of the majors their dependents pin.
